items.name: theme
items.title: Theme
items.description: The claudalisk design tokens as CSS variables, light and dark, mapped to Tailwind utilities.

items.name: problem-details
items.title: Problem Details
items.description: RFC 9457 Problem Details types, the ProblemError thrown for a failed request, and lookups for validation errors by field.

items.name: hypermedia
items.title: Hypermedia
items.description: Types for _links and _actions, and the shared/api helpers that follow a link and send an action with If-Match.

items.name: problem-field
items.title: Problem field
items.description: A labelled form field that shows the validation errors a Problem Details response gives for its name.

items.name: problem-alert
items.title: Problem alert
items.description: An alert that shows a Problem Details title and detail, and the validation errors no field shows.

items.name: action-button
items.title: Action button
items.description: A button that renders only when its action is in a representation's _actions, and sends the action's method to its href.

items.name: paged-table
items.title: Paged table
items.description: A data table on TanStack Table for a page of a collection, paged by following its next and prev links, and stacked into labelled cards on narrow screens when asked.

items.name: query-state
items.title: Query state
items.description: Loading, error and empty states for a TanStack Query result, with the data rendered once it is there.

items.name: color-scheme
items.title: Color scheme
items.description: Light and dark mode: applyColorScheme puts the .dark class and color-scheme on <html> from the stored choice or else the system preference, and a toggle stores the choice in localStorage.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: App shell
items.description: The app's layout: a sidebar with navigation links for React Router, a header and the main content.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: shadcn's table with a stacked variant that turns rows into cards labelled by each cell's data-label when its container is narrow.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: shadcn's badge with success and warning variants on the theme's tokens.

items.name: heading
items.title: Heading
items.description: Heading, a real h1 to h4 in the theme's type scale, and PageHeader, a page's h1 with its description and actions.

items.name: section-card
items.title: Section card
items.description: A card with a real heading, a description and an action, which is a region named by its heading when asked.

items.name: disclosure
items.title: Disclosure
items.description: A collapsible section opened by a button with a chevron, in place of details and summary.

items.name: pager
items.title: Pager
items.description: Previous and next buttons that follow a collection's prev and next links, with an optional page count, for lists that are not tables.

items.name: job
items.title: Job
items.description: The job resource's types, a hook that polls a job until it ends and follows the newest active job when a newer one supersedes it, and a panel that shows its status, progress, error and cancel action.

items.name: base
items.title: Base
items.description: Everything a new claudalisk app starts with: the theme and every base component.
